title: Dolly Parton’s Legacy on the Billboard 200 Chart: 7 Decades of Hit Albums
summary: She scored more top 40-charted sets in the 2020s than in any other decade.
body: For seven straight decades, from the 1960s on through the 2020s, the late Dolly Parton charted an iconic string of 50 albums on the all-genre Billboard 200 chart during her lifetime — including 15 top 40-charted sets. Following her passing on Aug. 25, Parton racked up a 16th top 40 set with Ultimate Dolly Parton . From her debut with Porter Wagoner on Just the Two of Us in 1969, on through her most recent studio album to debut, 2023’s Rockstar , the singer-songwriter left a remarkable impression on Billboard ’s signature album chart. Related Dolly Parton Hit Billboard’s Dance Charts, Too, And Even Earned a No. 1 Hit Dolly Parton’s Manager Details the Business Ventures ‘She Had Yet to Fulfill’ Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library Program Honored by Library of Congress: ‘Titan of Children’s Literacy’ Parton notched four early albums on the Billboard 200 with her former TV co-star and duet partner Wagoner in 1969-71. She charted her first solo entry also in 1969, with My Blue Ridge Mountain Boy . title: YSL’s ‘Slime Language 3’: All 41 Tracks Ranked
summary: The 41-song compilation is a peek into the present and future of Young Thug's label.
body: YSL shared the third installment of its popular Slime Language compilation series on Friday (Aug. 28), featuring Future , Travis Scott , Lil Baby and many more. If you asked someone any time between 2022 and 2025 if they thought Young Thug ’s Young Stoner Life label would put out another Slime Language compilation album, they probably would have said no. In that period, Gunna became completely distanced from the group, along with Yak Gotti, Lil Duke, YTB Trench,and FN DaDealer. Additionally, Nine Vicious left in 2025. Related Young Thug’s YSL Records Surprise-Drops ‘Slime Language 3’ Double Album The most important factor of all was Thugger being behind bars for more than two years due to the YSL RICO case . Fortunately, he was able to strike a plea deal and come home, but the damage to his label and Atlanta as a whole felt insurmountable. Many fallings-out occurred as a result of plea deals, betrayal and pride. Thug also had a tough time reorienting himself to the current music landscape, as his comeback album UY SCUTI did not land well for the masses (though it did make the top 10 of the Billboard 200, peaking at No. 6). title: Here Are All the K-pop Albums That Have Topped the Billboard 200: Full List
summary: BTS was the first K-pop act to top the all-genre chart; BLACKPINK was the first female K-pop act to do so.
body: ENHYPHEN ’s THE SIN: BLISS puts K-pop back in a familiar spot — No. 1 on the all-genre Billboard 200 chart. The EP is the 26th album or EP by a K-pop act to reach No. 1 on Billboard’s flagship albums chart in just over eight years. The first was BTS ’ Love Yourself: Tear in June 2018. Stray Kids has amassed nine No. 1 titles on the Billboard 200, which puts them out front among K-pop acts. BTS is second, with seven No. 1 titles. ATEEZ is next in line with three No. 1s. SuperM , BLACKPINK , TOMORROW X TOGETHER , NewJeans , TWICE and ENHYPHEN have all notched one No. 1 to date. In addition, one multi-artist K-pop soundtrack, KPop Demon Hunters , has reached No. 1. Related ENHYPEN Scores First No. 1 Album on Billboard 200 With ‘THE SIN : BLISS’ BLACKPINK was the first female K-pop act to land a No. 1 album on the Billboard 200. They scored with Born Pink in 2022. They were followed by NewJeans and TWICE. K-pop groups tend to be large ensembles. TWICE has nine members, one more than Stray Kids and ATEEZ. BTS has seven members, as did SuperM, which went on hiatus in mid-2021.  ENHYPHEN has six members. TOMORROW X TOGETHER and NewJeans each have five members. BLACK…

title: ENHYPEN Scores First No. 1 Album on Billboard 200 With ‘THE SIN : BLISS’
summary: Plus, Dolly Parton soars into the top five after her passing.
body: ENHYPEN claims its first No. 1 album on the Billboard 200 chart as THE SIN : BLISS debuts atop the ranking (dated Sept. 5). The set earned 98,000 equivalent album units in the United States in its first week (ending Aug. 27), according to Luminate. THE SIN : BLISS marks ENHYPEN’s seventh top 10, all achieved since 2022. The act had previously gone as high as No. 2, twice, with THE SIN : VANISH in January and ROMANCE : UNTOLD in 2024.   Related ENHYPEN Drops Latest Installment in ‘THE SIN’ Series With ‘BLISS’: Stream It Now Here Are All the K-pop Albums That Have Topped the Billboard 200: Full List Forever No. 1: Dolly Parton, ‘9 to 5’ Also in the top 10, Dolly Parton , who died on Aug. 25, tallies her fourth top 10-charted album, as the greatest hits collection Ultimate Dolly Parton reenters the chart at No. 5. The Billboard 200 chart ranks the most popular albums of the week in the U.S. based on multi-metric consumption as measured in equivalent album units, compiled by Luminate. title: Dolly Parton Honored at Grand Ole Opry Tribute With Carly Pearce, Jelly Roll & More
summary: The Nashville landmark dedicated its Saturday night show to celebrating the life and legacy of the late country icon.
body: The Grand Ole Opry is remembering Dolly Parton . On Saturday (Aug. 29), the Nashville landmark brought together Carly Pearce , Jelly Roll and a host of other artists to celebrate the life and legacy of the late country icon. Related Kacey Musgraves Pays Tribute to Dolly Parton With ‘Rainbow’ & ‘Here You Come Again’ Live in Boston Nashville Airport to Be Renamed for Dolly Parton, Tennessee Governor Announces Dolly Parton’s 25 Best Songs: Critics’ Picks “There are artists who make country music. And then there are artists who become part of its very heart. That’s Dolly Parton,” the Opry wrote on Instagram alongside photos from the concert. “Dolly, thank you for making the Opry, and country music, richer, brighter and unmistakably your own. You will forever be a cherished member of our Opry family.” The Opry dedicated its regularly scheduled Saturday night show to Parton, who was inducted into the legendary Nashville institution in 1969 and remained an Opry member for more than five decades. title: Every Song That Topped the U.K. Chart for 8 or More Weeks, But Didn’t Make the Top 10 on the Hot 100
summary: "Rein Me In” by Sam Fender and Olivia Dean is the first single to log 23 weeks at No. 1 in the U.K. It hasn't even made the top 40 on the Hot 100, but it's closing in.
body: UPDATE (Aug. 30): “Rein Me In” by Sam Fender and Olivia Dean logs its 23rd nonconsecutive week at No. 1 on the U.K.’s Official Singles Chart on the tally that was published on Friday (Aug. 28). The song hasn’t been nearly as big a hit in the U.S., though it isn’t done yet. It jumps from No. 50 to No. 45 in its 22nd week on the Billboard Hot 100 dated Aug. 29, its highest ranking to date. “Rein Me In” is the first single to log 23 weeks at No. 1 in the U.K., but it has yet to reach the top 10 (or even the top 40) on the Hot 100. In the 68 years that the Hot 100 has been in place, music fans in the U.S. and the U.K. have never been so far apart in their reactions to a song. Here’s an essay on how “Rein Me In” became the U.K.’s longest-running No. 1 single ever. And here’s a look at the song that previously held the record, Frankie Laine ‘s “I Believe.” PREVIOUSLY (April 23): Music fans in the United States and the United Kingdom often agree on big hits. body: 6 Min Read Grants The NSSC supports the Agency’s internal effort to create an environment conducive to streamlining and simplifying grants and cooperative agreements. The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), through the establishment of the NSSC, has transitioned to a consolidated model for the award and administration of all Agency grants and cooperative agreements. The consolidation is designed to achieve efficient and effective service, improve data quality, standardize processes, leverage skills and investments, and provide economies of scale. * Notice * The Payment Management System (PMS) is currently experiencing issues affecting Federal Financial Report (FFR) generation.
